Gameplay Updates: 
Character Update: Character will reduce stamina after health is zero.
Character Update: Character will die when health and stamina is zero.
Character Update: EggChin will not reduce stamina after health is zero.
Character Update: EggChin will not die when health and stamina is zero unless knock off from cliff.
Combo System Update: Characters last hit provide extra damage and knockback.
Gameplay Update: Spinning moves will stop camera rotations.
Gameplay Update: Blood Splash and Hit Effects
Gameplay Update: Characters spawn stars above head when stunned.
Movement Update: Player is not able to attack and move when received damage. 
UI Update: Character Image now rendered.
Camera Update: Camera Shake on Heavy Attacks

Bug Fixed: 
Gameplay Fixed: Combo reset when received damage.
Gameplay Fixed: Combo unable to hit at times.
Gameplay Fixed: Characters will now play stun animation when no health.
Gameplay Fixed: Characters will now play pain animation when got health.
Gameplay Fixed: Energy stop regenerate at times.
Environment Fixed: Tower projectile will only explode when contact.
